job.job_description:
Job Summary

Build, fine-tune, and deploy GenAI models that power creative tools for image, video, and voice applications.


Job Details

Full Time
Hyderabad


Responsibilities

Join our AI team to create next-gen solutions using cutting-edge generative models.
Develop and deploy AI models for image generation, face swap, and text-to-image
Fine-tune pretrained models (e.g., Stable Diffusion, StyleGAN, LoRA)
Optimize inference pipelines for speed, accuracy, and scalability
Collaborate with product and design teams to integrate GenAI features
Explore emerging trends in multimodal and creative AI


Requirements

0-2 years of experience in AI/ML (academic/research projects included)


Qualifications

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, AI, or related field
Strong Python skills and familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow
Understanding of neural networks, transformers, and generative models
Curiosity and passion for building creative AI applications
Knowledge of prompt engineering and model fine-tuning techniques


Skills Experience

Experience with Stable Diffusion, InstantID, or FaceSwap tools
Familiar with model serving tools (e.g., BentoML, Cog, FastAPI)
Exposure to GPU workflows, cloud deployment, or Docker
Bonus: experience with audio synthesis or GenAI video generation


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
